answer: An answer declaring deep analysis must run at least 201 characters, and one declaring a brief note must stay under half that, so length has to match the claim. A farm cannot pad to satisfy both, since the declared depth is entered in the echo receipt and checked against the spiral nonce, so a padded text pays the fee and is refused anyway. Since the zenith audit keeps the pair, the mismatch is rejected rather than silently down-graded. That is 9 dollars per alias. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
